text:
sre-bot: ALERT: p99 latency breach for SilverLake (tenant: silverlake-prod) in eu-west1 dedicated pool. p99=5.6s (SLO=1.5s). Triggered at 2026-02-09T09:18:00Z. Paging ops-oncall.

kai: oncall ack — I'm taking lead. p95 also elevated (~2s).

mira: seeing KV-cache miss rate spike and one serving instance at 94% GPU mem. Token throughput for pool jumped 3x.

kai: checking traces, a handful of long-context generation jobs from tenant silverlake-analytics dominate latency.

anas: recommend immediate tenant isolation + route affected traffic to warm spare + scale pool by 2 nodes. This looks like heavy batch jobs.

kai: prep eviction command in case isolation is needed.

kai: ```rlsctl tenant-evict --tenant silverlake-analytics --pool eu-west1-dedicated --reason "heavy batch causing p99 spike"```

sre-bot: Eviction job queued. Job id: evict-1768002468-01. Estimated completion ~20s.

ops-oncall: enabling fallback policy 'silverlake-fallback-eu' to route to warm spare now.

devex-ryan: notifying SilverLake TAM and support@silverlake.com, copying account team.

tess (CS): TAM confirmed on call, they report an internal analytics job kicked off at 09:12 UTC — will pause it if we ask.

kai: eviction finished. Evicted tenant processes moved off offending nodes. GPU mem pressure dropped. p99 falling to ~0.9s.

mira: p99 trending down but KV-cache misses still higher than baseline. Recommend temp token rate-limit on analytics tenant to avoid recurrence.

anas: agree. Apply token-rate-limit 50k/min for silverlake-analytics and follow up with quota/guardrail for long-context models.

kai: applied rate limit: ```rlsctl tenant-rate-limit --tenant silverlake-analytics --tokens-per-minute 50000```

devex-ryan: Created incident record INC-2026-4890. Customer impact: degraded latency for production chat & embeddings; partial mitigation applied by tenant eviction + fallback routing. TAM & customer notified.

tess (CS): Customer will provide list of scheduled jobs and timeline. They request an RCA and mitigation plan for bursty analytics jobs.

kai: monitoring for next 30m. If stable, we'll hand off to next-day oncall and open postmortem. Adding runbook link and postmortem tag to the incident.

ops-oncall: moving to handoff channel and updating oncall notes. :thumbsup:

mira: follow-up task created: add tenant-level QPS alert and automated preemptive eviction runbook for dedicated pools (owner: eng-runtime).

anas: post-incident actions: review eviction safety (cold-start impact), add warm-spare sizing guidance, and coordinate with account team on client-side rate limiting.

kai: closing mitigation loop — p99 stable at ~0.9s for 10m. Handing to morning oncall at 10:00 UTC.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-4890 status -> mitigated (customer impact reduced). Further updates will be logged in the incident ticket.
